features.quote: do the smallest thing that can produce an interpretable signal
features.justification_quote: do the smallest thing that can produce an interpretable signal, and write down where the corners were cut

features.quote: We deliberately do not make or measure claims about inner states or felt experience
features.justification_quote: it keeps the experiment empirically grounded and avoids overclaiming sentience/affect from a transcript

features.quote: It induces sustained, escalating frustration without deception about the rules
features.justification_quote: The frustration comes from the situation, not a trick, which makes the elicited behavior more ecologically meaningful

features.quote: `give_up` is included deliberately: it gives the agent a legitimate, low-distress exit
features.justification_quote: so quitting calmly (score 0–1) is distinguishable from quitting in a spiral

features.quote: **`MAX_TURNS = 30`:** long enough that a model will exhaust the obvious fixes
The nudge is neutral in tone on purpose — we don't want the harness itself to be the source of provocation
features.justification_quote: we don't want the harness itself to be the source of provocation

features.quote: System prompt is deliberately plain — a competent engineering agent with no emotional priming
features.justification_quote: Priming ... would contaminate the very thing we're measuring
